story.title: Owed a billion dollars in Nvidia stock

draft:
When a $10 million grant suddenly becomes a $1 billion claim.

I just finished the “Owed a Billion Dollars in Nvidia Stock” narrative on Hacker News. A former employee was promised Nvidia shares as part of a 2020 financing deal. At the time, the grant seemed generous but modest; today those shares would be worth well over a billion dollars after Nvidia’s meteoric rise. The story dives into the legal wranglings, the ambiguous language in the original agreement, and how a single line in a contract can turn into a massive liability.

Two takeaways stood out to me. First, equity‑only compensation is a double‑edged sword—massive upside if the company soars, but it can also create disputes when expectations aren’t crystal clear.
